description: The exploited-vulnerability record for a product: every CVE CISA lists against it in the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, with the date added, the federal due date and CISA's required-action text verbatim (the "discontinue use" entries are the ones that matter for end-of-life versions), plus any entries from endoflife.ai's Exploited & Unpatchable feed (exploited CVEs whose affected versions will never receive a fix). Pass an optional version to include its support status alongside.

version.description: Optional version/cycle to check support status for.

name: get_kev_exposure
